1. (Currently amended) A dynamic laminar structure, for example for working tools and machines, comprising a lamination of at least two layers and an internal layer, wherein the internal layer is a combination of two or more components, __wherein the lamination comprises first and second outer layers and at least two adhesive layers, the first and second outer layers each having a circular shape, a medial section positioned between the first and second outer layers, a first adhesive layer positioned on a first side of the medial section and bonded to the first outer layer, and a second adhesive layer positioned on a second side of the medial section and bonded to the second outer layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with the first and second outer layers respectively__.

2. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

3. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a honeycomb structure.

4. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 wherein the medial section comprises a composite material.

5. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 further including a weld ring at least partially interposed between an outer perimeter of the first and second outer layers.

6. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is bonded to the medial section.

7. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 further including a plurality of cutting segments bonded to an outer perimeter of the weld ring.

8. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 wherein the weld ring is continuous.

9. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 285 further including an inner ring coupled to an inner perimeter of the medial section, wherein the inner ring includes a central opening for accommodating a drive shaft.

10. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 290 wherein the inner ring is bonded to the medial section.

11. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 281 further including a segmented weld ring at least partially interposed between an outer perimeter of the first and second outer layers and a plurality of cutting segments.

12. (Currently amended) The dynamic laminar structure of claim 293 wherein the segmented weld ring is bonded to the medial section.
